tuples.evidence_lens: the constitutional texts, election records, ministry files, and the press of each regime

tuples.episode_object: decolonisation and the end of the empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: France, north Africa, west Africa and southeast Asia across two decades
tuples.mechanism: an empire that ended in two wars and a dozen negotiated transfers, and reshaped the metropolitan state on the way
tuples.evidence_lens: the war records, the independence agreements, referendum results, and the migration and repatriation files

tuples.episode_object: Portugal itself, told whole from a county to a republic
tuples.time_place_scope: the western strip of Iberia and the Atlantic across nine centuries
tuples.mechanism: a small kingdom whose entire strategy was the Atlantic, because the land frontier was closed by a larger neighbour
tuples.evidence_lens: royal charters, the chancery registers, the fleet and customs records, and the treaties with its neighbour

tuples.episode_object: the Portuguese voyages of exploration, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the African coast, the Atlantic islands and the route to India across a century
tuples.mechanism: a state-directed programme of incremental coastal voyages, each one financed by the trade the last one opened
tuples.evidence_lens: voyage accounts and charts, the crown's own instructions, and the padrao stones left along the coast

tuples.episode_object: the Atlantic islands, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Madeira, the Azores, Cape Verde and the gulf islands across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: uninhabited islands settled as sugar plantations, which is where the Atlantic plantation model was worked out first
tuples.evidence_lens: settlement charters, sugar production records, shipping registers, and the island administration files

tuples.episode_object: the Portuguese in west Africa, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the coast from the Senegal to Angola across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: fortified trading posts on a coast whose interior was never entered, buying from African states on their terms
tuples.evidence_lens: fort archaeology, trade and shipping registers, treaty documents, and the mission records

tuples.episode_object: the Estado da India, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Indian Ocean from east Africa to Japan across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a chain of fortified ports and a licensing system imposed on a sea where trade had been unarmed
tuples.evidence_lens: the licence and customs registers, fort archaeology, the crown's correspondence, and the accounts of Asian merchants

tuples.episode_object: Goa and Portuguese India, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the western Indian coast across four and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a colonial capital that outlived the empire it served by three centuries, held for prestige long after profit
tuples.evidence_lens: administration and church records, land registers, the inquisition files, and the transfer documents

tuples.episode_object: Portuguese Malacca and southeast Asia, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the straits, the spice islands and the China coast across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a chain of captured ports too thinly held to control a sea, taken one by one by a better-financed rival
tuples.evidence_lens: conquest and siege accounts, customs records, the Dutch company's capture files, and the fort archaeology

tuples.episode_object: Macau, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Pearl river estuary across four and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a settlement held by permission rather than by conquest, whose survival depended on being useful to two empires
tuples.evidence_lens: the lease and permission documents, customs records, church archives, and the transfer negotiations

tuples.episode_object: the Portuguese in Japan, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern Japanese ports and the sea route from Macau across a century
tuples.mechanism: a trade and a mission that arrived together, prospered together and were expelled together
tuples.evidence_lens: the missionary letters and reports, trade registers, the expulsion edicts, and the persecution records

tuples.episode_object: Brazil, told whole from a landfall to an independent empire
tuples.time_place_scope: the Atlantic coast, the interior and the Amazon across three and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a colony that began as a dyewood coast, became a sugar and then a gold economy, and ended by inheriting its own monarchy
tuples.evidence_lens: colonial administration records, plantation and mining registers, shipping records, and the independence documents

tuples.episode_object: Brazilian sugar and the northeast, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the northeastern coast and its plantation zone across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: the first great plantation economy of the Atlantic, and the model every later colony copied
tuples.evidence_lens: mill registers, shipping and tax records, Dutch occupation documents, and the plantation inventories

tuples.episode_object: Brazilian gold and the interior, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the central highlands and the routes to the coast across a century
tuples.mechanism: a gold rush that moved a colony's population inland and its capital south, and paid for a European court's debts
tuples.evidence_lens: mining registers, the royal fifth accounts, road and settlement records, and the town council documents

tuples.episode_object: the Amazon and the Portuguese frontier, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the great river basin and its tributaries across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a frontier claimed by river forts and mission stations, and legalised by a treaty that accepted occupation as title
tuples.evidence_lens: the fort and mission records, boundary commission files, the treaty texts, and the expedition journals

tuples.episode_object: Portuguese Angola and the south Atlantic, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Angolan coast, the interior and the Brazilian coast opposite across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: an Atlantic economy linking two colonies directly, in which the ships mattered more than the metropolis did
tuples.evidence_lens: shipping and trade registers, the administration files at both ends, and the interior campaign records

tuples.episode_object: Portuguese Mozambique and the Indian Ocean, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the east African coast and the Zambezi across four and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a coast held as a stopping point on a longer route, developed only when the route stopped mattering
tuples.evidence_lens: customs and station records, the prazo grants, mission archives, and the boundary agreements

tuples.episode_object: the Portuguese caravel and navigation, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Atlantic, the Indian Ocean and the Pacific across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a hull and a rig that could sail against the wind, plus a method of finding latitude, which together opened the oceans
tuples.evidence_lens: shipwreck excavation, navigation manuals and tables, chart collections, and the shipyard records

tuples.episode_object: the Portuguese and the Treaty of Tordesillas, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Atlantic, both Americas and the far east across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: two crowns dividing an unmeasured world along a line neither could locate, and three centuries of arguing about it
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty texts, the boundary commission records, chart and longitude disputes, and the later settlements

tuples.episode_object: the union of the crowns and the recovery, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Portugal, Spain and the overseas empire across a century
tuples.mechanism: sixty years under a neighbour's crown, during which the empire's enemies became its enemies and took most of Asia
tuples.evidence_lens: the union terms, the loss records in Asia and Brazil, the restoration correspondence, and the treaty of peace

tuples.episode_object: the Lisbon earthquake and its century, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the capital, the country and the empire across a century
tuples.mechanism: a capital destroyed in one morning and rebuilt to a single plan by a minister who used the disaster to reorganise a state
tuples.evidence_lens: the survey and rebuilding records, the ministerial correspondence, the seismic accounts, and the tax measures

tuples.episode_object: the end of the Portuguese empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Africa, Asia and the Atlantic islands across two decades
tuples.mechanism: the last European empire to decolonise, which ended when the wars it was fighting overthrew the government at home
tuples.evidence_lens: the war records, the independence agreements, the transfer documents, and the migration registers

tuples.episode_object: Spain itself, told whole from the union of two crowns to a republic
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula, the Mediterranean, the Americas and the Pacific across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a monarchy of separate kingdoms sharing one king, which made a global empire and never made a single state
tuples.evidence_lens: the council records, treasury accounts, the cortes documents of each kingdom, and the colonial administration files

tuples.episode_object: Castile and Aragon, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula's plateau, the Mediterranean coast and the islands across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: two crowns with different constitutions joined by a marriage, in which one paid for the empire and the other kept its privileges
tuples.evidence_lens: the marriage capitulations, cortes records of both crowns, treasury accounts, and the viceregal correspondence

tuples.episode_object: the Aragonese Mediterranean, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the eastern Spanish coast, the Balearics, Sicily, Sardinia and Naples across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: a maritime empire of separate kingdoms run by viceroys and merchant consulates rather than by conquest administration
tuples.evidence_lens: consulate and merchant records, viceregal files, treaty texts, and the parliamentary records of each kingdom

tuples.episode_object: the Spanish conquest of the Americas, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Caribbean, Mexico, Peru and the frontiers across a century
tuples.mechanism: a conquest carried out by licensed private expeditions, which the crown then spent a century trying to bring under control
tuples.evidence_lens: the licence and capitulation contracts, conquest accounts, the new laws, and the residencia investigations

tuples.episode_object: the Spanish colonial administration, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Americas and the Philippines across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: an empire governed by written appeal to a distant council, which was slow, legalistic and surprisingly hard to ignore
tuples.evidence_lens: the council of the Indies files, viceregal correspondence, the inspection records, and the court case archives

tuples.episode_object: the silver fleets and the Atlantic system, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Caribbean, the Atlantic and the Spanish ports across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: an annual convoy system that carried a continent's silver and set the rhythm of European finance for two centuries
tuples.evidence_lens: the fleet registers, treasury records at both ends, shipwreck excavation, and the merchant guild archives

tuples.episode_object: Spanish Mexico, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the highlands, the mining north and the coasts across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a viceroyalty built on silver and indigenous towns, whose institutions outlasted the empire almost unchanged
tuples.evidence_lens: mining and mint records, indigenous town archives, church registers, and the viceregal files

tuples.episode_object: Spanish Peru and the south, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Andes, the coast and the southern cone across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a viceroyalty organised around one mountain of silver and the labour draft that fed it
tuples.evidence_lens: the mining and labour draft registers, viceregal inspection records, and the tribute and parish documents

tuples.episode_object: the Spanish Philippines, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the island group and the Pacific route across three and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: an Asian colony administered from Mexico and paid for by a single annual ship, which made it a Pacific rather than an Asian possession
tuples.evidence_lens: the galleon registers, the administration and mission files, and the customs records at both ends

tuples.episode_object: the Spanish Netherlands and the revolt, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Low Countries and the Spanish road across a century
tuples.mechanism: a revolt over taxes and religion in the empire's richest province, which took eighty years and bankrupted the crown repeatedly
tuples.evidence_lens: the tax and revolt records, army pay accounts, the treaty texts, and the correspondence of the governors

tuples.episode_object: Spanish Italy, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Naples, Sicily, Milan and Sardinia across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: provinces that funded the monarchy's wars and kept their own laws, which made them profitable and politically inert
tuples.evidence_lens: the viceregal accounts, tax and levy records, and the parliamentary documents of each kingdom

tuples.episode_object: the Spanish Inquisition, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula, the islands and the Americas across three and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a royal tribunal rather than a papal one, whose records are the most detailed social archive of the early modern period
tuples.evidence_lens: the trial records in enormous quantity, the edicts, the visitation reports, and the abolition documents

tuples.episode_object: the expulsions and the converted communities, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula and the Mediterranean diaspora across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: the removal of two large populations for reasons of religious uniformity, and the economic hole each removal left
tuples.evidence_lens: the expulsion decrees, property confiscation inventories, inquisition files, and the records of the receiving countries

tuples.episode_object: Spanish silver and world prices, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Americas, Spain, Europe and Asia across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: the injection of a continent's silver into a world economy, which raised prices everywhere and enriched the intermediaries
tuples.evidence_lens: mint and shipping records, price series across three continents, and the customs registers

tuples.episode_object: the Spanish American frontiers, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern deserts, the southern plains and the forests across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: frontiers held by missions and presidios rather than by settlement, which stabilised where the horse and the rains allowed
tuples.evidence_lens: mission and presidio records, expedition journals, and the treaty and campaign documents with frontier peoples

tuples.episode_object: the Bourbon reforms in the empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Spain and the Americas across a century
tuples.mechanism: a reorganisation designed to extract more revenue, which worked and simultaneously created the grievance that broke the empire
tuples.evidence_lens: the reform decrees, revenue statistics, intendant reports, and the rebellion trial records

tuples.episode_object: Spanish American independence, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Americas from Mexico to the southern cone across two decades
tuples.mechanism: a crisis of legitimacy caused by the capture of the king, resolved by fifteen years of war and a dozen republics
tuples.evidence_lens: the junta declarations, campaign correspondence, constitutional texts, and the treaty and recognition documents

tuples.episode_object: Cuba, Puerto Rico and the last colonies, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Caribbean and the Pacific across a century
tuples.mechanism: the last remnants of an empire, kept as sugar and tobacco economies and lost in a single short war
tuples.evidence_lens: the sugar and plantation records, colonial administration files, the war documents, and the treaty of cession

tuples.episode_object: Spain in Africa and the Mediterranean, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Morocco, the western Sahara, Guinea and the Mediterranean coast across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: presidios and protectorates held as a defensive glacis and a national compensation for a lost empire
tuples.evidence_lens: the presidio and protectorate records, campaign documents, and the withdrawal agreements

tuples.episode_object: Spain after empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula and the islands across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a country that lost an empire and spent the next century arguing about what kind of country was left
tuples.evidence_lens: constitutional texts, election and census records, the parliamentary debates, and the press of the period

coverage_profiles.subject: the Italian city-states and papal Rome

tuples.episode_object: Venice, told whole from lagoon refugees to a surrendered republic
tuples.time_place_scope: the lagoon, the Adriatic, the Aegean and the mainland across eleven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a republic of merchants that treated the state as a firm, with a constitution designed to prevent any one family winning
tuples.evidence_lens: the senate and council minutes in unbroken series, the notarial archives, and the arsenal and customs records

tuples.episode_object: Florence, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Arno valley and Tuscany across eight centuries
tuples.mechanism: a banking and cloth city whose republican constitution was captured by one family without ever being abolished
tuples.evidence_lens: the guild and commune records, tax survey registers, bank ledgers, and the private diaries of its citizens

tuples.episode_object: Genoa, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ligurian coast, the western Mediterranean and the Black Sea across nine centuries
tuples.mechanism: a republic that outsourced its own state functions to private companies, which made it flexible and permanently unstable
tuples.evidence_lens: the notarial registers, the company charters, colony records, and the bank of Saint George's archives

tuples.episode_object: Milan and the Lombard plain, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern Italian plain across ten centuries
tuples.mechanism: an inland power with the best agriculture and the best armourers in Italy, always the prize in every foreign invasion
tuples.evidence_lens: the ducal chancery records, irrigation and land documents, and the campaign and treaty texts

tuples.episode_object: the papal state, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: central Italy and the church's wider claims across twelve centuries
tuples.mechanism: a territorial monarchy attached to a religious office, elective, and therefore reinvented every single reign
tuples.evidence_lens: the papal registers, the territorial administration records, conclave documents, and the treaty texts

tuples.episode_object: Rome as a city, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Tiber bend and its hills across twenty-eight centuries
tuples.mechanism: a city that shrank to a village inside its own walls and was rebuilt by an institution that needed it as a stage
tuples.evidence_lens: the building and restoration records, pilgrimage accounts, population estimates, and the excavation record

tuples.episode_object: the Avignon papacy and the schism, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Rhone valley, Rome and Latin Christendom across a century
tuples.mechanism: a papacy relocated for safety, and the three-way schism that followed when it tried to come back
tuples.evidence_lens: the papal registers from both courts, council acts, and the correspondence of the obediences

tuples.episode_object: Naples and the southern kingdom, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern peninsula and Sicily across nine centuries
tuples.mechanism: a kingdom repeatedly conquered by foreign dynasties, whose barons survived every one of them intact
tuples.evidence_lens: the royal registers, the baronial land records, tax and feudal service documents, and the campaign accounts

tuples.episode_object: Sicily under its many rulers, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the island and its straits across three millennia
tuples.mechanism: an island whose fertility and position made it the first thing any Mediterranean power wanted and the hardest to keep
tuples.evidence_lens: the successive administrative archives, the land and grain records, and the accounts of each conquest

tuples.episode_object: Pisa and the maritime republics, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Tyrrhenian coast and the western Mediterranean across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: the fourth maritime republic, which lost its harbour to silt and its independence to a neighbour, in that order
tuples.evidence_lens: the commune records, the harbour silting evidence, and the treaty and conquest documents

tuples.episode_object: Siena and the smaller communes, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Tuscan hills across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a commune that governed by committee and painted its own constitution on the wall, and was absorbed after one siege
tuples.evidence_lens: the commune's records, the painted government cycle, banking documents, and the siege accounts

tuples.episode_object: the Italian bankers, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Florence, Genoa, Siena and the courts of Europe across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: merchant banks lending to kings, which is profitable until a king defaults and then fatal within a year
tuples.evidence_lens: the bank ledgers, loan contracts, bankruptcy records, and the correspondence of the branch managers

tuples.episode_object: the Italian renaissance as a system, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula's courts and cities across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: competitive patronage between small states, in which art was a diplomatic instrument and artists were mobile assets
tuples.evidence_lens: the commission contracts, court account books, artists' correspondence, and the inventories of collections

tuples.episode_object: the Italian wars, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole peninsula across sixty-five years
tuples.mechanism: the moment Italy's wealth and division attracted two larger monarchies, after which it was a theatre rather than an actor
tuples.evidence_lens: the campaign records, treaty texts, diplomatic correspondence, and the fortification building accounts

tuples.episode_object: Venetian Crete and the Aegean empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Aegean islands and Crete across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a colonial system of feudal grants over a Greek population, which produced revolt regularly and revenue reliably
tuples.evidence_lens: the colonial administration records, the revolt files, land grant registers, and the siege accounts

tuples.episode_object: the Venetian arsenal and shipbuilding, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the lagoon and the Mediterranean across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: a state shipyard producing standardised hulls on a production line, three centuries before anyone else did
tuples.evidence_lens: the arsenal records and inventories, the shipbuilding regulations, and the fleet mobilisation documents

tuples.episode_object: the papal conclave and church government, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Rome and Latin Christendom across nine centuries
tuples.mechanism: an electoral system designed to prevent outside interference, which produced long vacancies and short reigns instead
tuples.evidence_lens: the conclave records and capitulations, the electoral bulls, and the ambassadorial reports

tuples.episode_object: the Italian plague years, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula's cities and countryside across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: cities that invented quarantine, health boards and travel documents because they had no other tool at all
tuples.evidence_lens: the health board records, burial registers, quarantine station archaeology, and the merchant correspondence

tuples.episode_object: Italian unification, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula, the islands and the great powers across seventy years
tuples.mechanism: the absorption of every Italian state by the one that had an army and a foreign alliance, presented as a national movement
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty and plebiscite records, parliamentary debates, campaign documents, and the press

tuples.episode_object: Italian emigration, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula and the Americas, north Africa and northern Europe across a century
tuples.mechanism: the departure of a quarter of a country's population, and the remittance economy that kept the villages standing
tuples.evidence_lens: emigration registers, ship passenger lists, remittance records, and the returning migrants' property purchases

coverage_profiles.subject: the Low Countries and the Dutch republic

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch republic, told whole from a revolt to a French occupation
tuples.time_place_scope: the seven provinces, the North Sea and the wider world across two and a quarter centuries
tuples.mechanism: a federation with no head of state that out-financed monarchies, because its debt was cheap and its taxes were consented to
tuples.evidence_lens: the states general resolutions, the provincial accounts, the company archives, and the notarial records

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch revolt, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Low Countries and the Spanish road across eight decades
tuples.mechanism: a tax and religion revolt that turned into a war of independence, fought largely by cutting the enemy's supply line
tuples.evidence_lens: the placards and petitions, army pay and siege records, correspondence of both sides, and the treaty of peace

tuples.episode_object: Amsterdam, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Amstel dam and the North Sea across eight centuries
tuples.mechanism: a city that made itself the world's warehouse by keeping goods cheap to store and cheap to insure
tuples.evidence_lens: the notarial and exchange records, warehouse and canal building files, port registers, and the bank archives

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch East India Company, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the archipelago, the Indian Ocean, Japan and the Cape across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a chartered company with sovereign powers, profitable for a century and insolvent for its last decades
tuples.evidence_lens: the company's enormous archive, its ledgers and shipping lists, and the charters and dissolution documents

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch West India Company and the Atlantic, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Brazil, the Caribbean, west Africa and North America across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a company chartered for privateering as much as trade, which is a business model that ends with the war
tuples.evidence_lens: the company records, privateering prize accounts, the Brazilian occupation files, and the colony transfer documents

tuples.episode_object: New Netherland and the Hudson, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Hudson valley and the surrounding coast across half a century and after
tuples.mechanism: a fur colony with too few settlers, traded away in a treaty for a sugar island that seemed more valuable
tuples.evidence_lens: the colony records, the fur trade accounts, the treaty of cession, and the town records after the transfer

tuples.episode_object: Dutch Brazil, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the northeastern Brazilian coast across a quarter century
tuples.mechanism: a sugar colony taken and held for twenty-four years, and lost because a company could not match a settled population
tuples.evidence_lens: the company records, the governor's scientific expedition documents, and the reconquest accounts

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch in Japan and the eastern trade, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the artificial island in Nagasaki bay and the sea route across two and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: the single European trading privilege in a closed country, held by agreeing to every condition imposed
tuples.evidence_lens: the factory day registers kept continuously, the trade ledgers, and the translated scientific works

tuples.episode_object: the Cape colony under the company, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the southwestern cape and its hinterland across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a refreshment station that grew a settler farming society nobody had planned and nobody could stop
tuples.evidence_lens: the company post records, land grant registers, slave records, and the frontier reports

tuples.episode_object: Dutch water engineering, told as one very long life
tuples.time_place_scope: the delta, the polders and the coast across a millennium
tuples.mechanism: a country largely below sea level, whose water boards are older than its state and outlived every government it had
tuples.evidence_lens: the water board records in unbroken series, dyke and polder engineering files, and the flood accounts

tuples.episode_object: the Flemish cities, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the county of Flanders and the North Sea coast across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: cloth towns whose wealth depended on English wool and whose politics were made by weavers, not by counts
tuples.evidence_lens: the town accounts and guild records, cloth hall archives, and the treaty and revolt documents

tuples.episode_object: Bruges, Antwerp and the shifting entrepot, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Flemish and Brabant coast and rivers across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: an entrepot that moved three times as harbours silted and wars closed rivers, each move ending one city's golden age
tuples.evidence_lens: the port and customs records, the silting and river closure evidence, and the merchant nation archives

tuples.episode_object: the Burgundian Netherlands, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Low Countries and the Burgundian lands across a century
tuples.mechanism: a state assembled from seventeen provinces by purchase and marriage, which was the richest in Europe and lasted four generations
tuples.evidence_lens: the ducal accounts and ordinances, the provincial privilege charters, and the court and ceremonial records

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch golden age economy, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the republic, the Baltic and the world across a century
tuples.mechanism: a bulk carrying trade in grain and timber that funded everything else, which is the unglamorous base under the famous part
tuples.evidence_lens: the Sound toll registers, freight rate series, notarial contracts, and the shipping and insurance records

tuples.episode_object: Dutch art as an industry, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the republic's cities across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a mass market for paintings bought by ordinary households, which produced volume, specialisation and low prices
tuples.evidence_lens: inventory and probate records, guild registers, auction catalogues, and the surviving paintings themselves

tuples.episode_object: the Dutch and the Baltic grain trade, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the North Sea, the Sound and the Baltic ports across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: the carrying of eastern grain to western Europe, which fed cities and made the carriers the richest people involved
tuples.evidence_lens: the Sound toll registers year by year, freight contracts, and the port records at both ends

tuples.episode_object: Dutch science and printing, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the republic's university towns across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a publishing industry that printed what other countries banned, which made a small country the continent's library
tuples.evidence_lens: the printers' output records, censorship files elsewhere, university archives, and the correspondence of scholars

tuples.episode_object: the Batavian revolution and the French years, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the republic and its colonies across two decades
tuples.mechanism: a federation converted by force into a unitary state, which survived the occupation that imposed it
tuples.evidence_lens: the constitutional texts, the occupation administration records, and the colonial transfer documents

tuples.episode_object: Belgium's separation, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern provinces and the great powers across two decades
tuples.mechanism: a union of two very different economies dissolved by a revolt, and guaranteed by a neutrality that later invited invasion
tuples.evidence_lens: the union treaty and the separation treaties, parliamentary debates, and the diplomatic correspondence

tuples.episode_object: the Netherlands and its empire's end, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the archipelago, the Caribbean and the Netherlands across two decades
tuples.mechanism: a colonial power that tried to return after an occupation and found the colony had already declared itself
tuples.evidence_lens: the independence declarations, the war and negotiation records, the transfer agreements, and the migration files

coverage_profiles.subject: Britain, Ireland and the British empire

tuples.episode_object: Britain, told whole from Roman withdrawal to a modern state
tuples.time_place_scope: the islands, the seas around them and the wider world across sixteen centuries
tuples.mechanism: an island that could put its defence into a navy instead of an army, which shaped its constitution as much as its wars
tuples.evidence_lens: the parliamentary records, treasury accounts, admiralty archives, and the colonial office files

tuples.episode_object: England's making, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the country south of the northern border across a millennium
tuples.mechanism: the earliest unified kingdom in western Europe, with a tax survey and a shire system that outlasted every dynasty
tuples.evidence_lens: the great land survey, the pipe rolls, the charter and statute record, and the county administrative documents

tuples.episode_object: the Norman conquest and its aftermath, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: England, Normandy and the Welsh and Scottish borders across a century
tuples.mechanism: the replacement of an entire landholding class within twenty years, recorded in a survey made to tax the result
tuples.evidence_lens: the land survey itself, castle building sequences, the charter record, and the chronicles of both sides

tuples.episode_object: English common law and parliament, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: England and eventually much of the world across nine centuries
tuples.mechanism: law made by decided cases and a tax-granting assembly, two institutions that constrained the crown by being useful to it
tuples.evidence_lens: the court plea rolls, the statute book, parliamentary rolls, and the law reports

tuples.episode_object: Ireland under English rule, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the island and the Irish sea across eight centuries
tuples.mechanism: a colony next door governed as a kingdom, whose land was redistributed three times in five centuries
tuples.evidence_lens: the plantation and confiscation records, the parliamentary journals, land surveys, and the famine relief files

tuples.episode_object: Scotland and the union, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the north of Britain and the seas across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a kingdom that kept its law and church in a union that abolished its parliament, which is an unusual bargain
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty of union and its debates, the burgh and kirk records, and the estate and improvement documents

tuples.episode_object: the English reformation, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: England, Wales and Ireland across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a religious change begun for a dynastic reason and completed by the transfer of a fifth of the country's land
tuples.evidence_lens: the dissolution inventories and land sale records, the statutes, visitation records, and parish accounts

tuples.episode_object: the English civil wars and the republic, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the three kingdoms across two decades
tuples.mechanism: a war over who controls the army and the church, which produced the only English republic and then undid it
tuples.evidence_lens: the parliamentary and army records, the newsbooks, the trial documents, and the restoration settlement

tuples.episode_object: the British navy, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the world's oceans across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: a permanent professional fleet funded by a taxing parliament, which is what made a small country a global power
tuples.evidence_lens: the admiralty and navy board records, ship logs and muster books, dockyard accounts, and the prize court files

tuples.episode_object: the British in India, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the subcontinent and the Indian Ocean across three and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a company that became a government, and a government that inherited a revenue system it never fundamentally changed
tuples.evidence_lens: the company and India office records, revenue settlement documents, army records, and the parliamentary inquiries

tuples.episode_object: the British Caribbean, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the islands and the Atlantic across three and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: sugar islands that were worth more than the mainland colonies, and whose politics were made entirely by that fact
tuples.evidence_lens: the plantation and shipping registers, colonial assembly records, and the emancipation compensation files

tuples.episode_object: British North America and the thirteen colonies, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Atlantic seaboard and the interior across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: settler colonies with their own assemblies, which made a tax dispute into a constitutional one within a decade
tuples.evidence_lens: the colonial assembly records, the customs and trade files, the war correspondence, and the peace treaty

tuples.episode_object: British settlement in Australia, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the continent and its coasts across two and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: a penal colony that became a settler society, expanding along the rivers and the wool frontier
tuples.evidence_lens: the convict transportation registers, land grant records, pastoral leases, and the frontier and mission documents

tuples.episode_object: New Zealand and the Pacific colonies, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the islands and the southwest Pacific across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a colony founded on a treaty in two languages whose two texts do not say the same thing, and still do not
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty texts and their translations, land purchase records, war documents, and the court and tribunal files

tuples.episode_object: British Africa, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: west, east, central and southern Africa across a century
tuples.mechanism: a scramble for territory driven as much by denying rivals as by any expected revenue, administered on the cheap
tuples.evidence_lens: the boundary and concession agreements, colonial office files, chartered company records, and the tax registers

tuples.episode_object: the abolition of the slave trade and slavery, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Britain, the Atlantic and the empire across a century
tuples.mechanism: a national campaign that ended a trade and then compensated the owners rather than the enslaved
tuples.evidence_lens: the parliamentary debates, the naval patrol records, the compensation registers, and the apprenticeship files

tuples.episode_object: the industrial revolution in Britain, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the coalfields, the mill towns and the ports across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: cheap coal beside iron and water, plus a patent system and a market, which is a combination no one else had at once
tuples.evidence_lens: the patent records, factory and mine inspection reports, census occupational data, and the company accounts

tuples.episode_object: British railways and infrastructure, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the islands and the empire across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: private companies building a network with no plan, which was fast, duplicative and had to be nationalised eventually
tuples.evidence_lens: the parliamentary bills for each line, company accounts, engineering records, and the traffic statistics

tuples.episode_object: the British empire's government, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole empire across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a system with no single constitution, in which each possession had a different legal relationship to the same crown
tuples.evidence_lens: the colonial office and dominions files, the constitutional acts for each territory, and the imperial conference records

tuples.episode_object: the end of the British empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Asia, Africa, the Caribbean and the Pacific across four decades
tuples.mechanism: a rapid withdrawal driven by cost and by war exhaustion, in which the timetable was usually set by the colony
tuples.evidence_lens: the independence acts and constitutions, the transfer of power files, and the boundary commission records

tuples.episode_object: Russia, told whole from a river town to a revolution
tuples.time_place_scope: the forest, the steppe, Siberia and the Pacific across eleven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a state that expanded across a continent with almost no natural frontier, and organised everything around holding it
tuples.evidence_lens: the chronicles, the chancery records, land and census registers, and the ministry archives

tuples.episode_object: Kievan Rus, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the rivers between the Baltic and the Black Sea across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: a river trading state whose princes divided the inheritance among all sons, which dissolved it within four generations
tuples.evidence_lens: the primary chronicle, birch bark letters, church foundation records, and the treaties with Byzantium

tuples.episode_object: Novgorod, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern lakes, the rivers and the fur country across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: a merchant republic that hired its princes and was annexed for exactly that reason by a monarchy that could not tolerate it
tuples.evidence_lens: the birch bark letters in thousands, the veche records, the Hanseatic correspondence, and the annexation documents

tuples.episode_object: the Mongol yoke and the rise of Moscow, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the forest zone and the steppe frontier across two and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: the delegation of tax collection to one principality, which made it rich, indispensable and eventually independent
tuples.evidence_lens: the khan's patents, monastic chronicles, tribute records, and the church and princely correspondence

tuples.episode_object: Muscovy, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the forest zone, the steppe frontier and the north across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: service tenure, in which land was held only in exchange for military service, which tied a nobility permanently to the state
tuples.evidence_lens: the service registers, land grant documents, chancery records, and the accounts of foreign embassies

tuples.episode_object: the Russian conquest of Siberia, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole of northern Asia to the Pacific across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a fur rush across a continent by small parties following rivers, ahead of any state that could govern them
tuples.evidence_lens: the fur tribute records, fort building files, expedition reports, and the indigenous petition documents

tuples.episode_object: Russian America and the Pacific, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Alaska, the Aleutians and the north Pacific coast across a century and a half
tuples.mechanism: a company colony at the end of the longest supply line in the world, sold because it could not be defended
tuples.evidence_lens: the company records, the fur harvest data, the mission archives, and the treaty of sale

tuples.episode_object: Peter's reforms, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole empire, the Baltic and the new capital across four decades
tuples.mechanism: the forced construction of a navy, a bureaucracy and a capital at once, financed by a poll tax on every male soul
tuples.evidence_lens: the reform decrees, the poll tax registers, the shipyard and construction records, and the diplomatic correspondence

tuples.episode_object: Saint Petersburg, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the marshes at the head of the gulf across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a capital built on a swamp for access to a sea, which cost enormously in labour and paid for itself in trade
tuples.evidence_lens: the construction records and labour levies, the port and customs data, and the flood and building files

tuples.episode_object: Russian serfdom, told whole from origin to emancipation
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole empire across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: the legal binding of a majority of the population to land, tightened over two centuries and ended in a single act
tuples.evidence_lens: the law codes, estate inventories and soul registers, the emancipation statutes, and the redemption payment records

tuples.episode_object: Catherine's empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the steppe, the Black Sea, Poland and the whole state across four decades
tuples.mechanism: expansion in three directions at once, paid for by the same nobility whose privileges the expansion confirmed
tuples.evidence_lens: the legislative commission records, the partition treaties, provincial reform files, and the correspondence

tuples.episode_object: Russian Poland and the western provinces, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the country between the Vistula and the Dnieper across a century and a quarter
tuples.mechanism: provinces acquired by partition and governed by rotating between concession and repression for a hundred years
tuples.evidence_lens: the partition treaties, the uprising and repression files, the language and school ordinances, and the land records

tuples.episode_object: the Caucasus and Russian expansion, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the mountains, the two seas and the highlands across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a fifty-year mountain war and a deportation, which is what conquering vertical country actually costs
tuples.evidence_lens: the campaign records, the deportation and resettlement files, the treaty documents, and the local chronicles

tuples.episode_object: Russian Central Asia, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the steppe, the oases and the mountain frontier across a century
tuples.mechanism: conquest by railway and by frontier officers acting ahead of their orders, and cotton grown for a distant industry
tuples.evidence_lens: the military campaign records, the railway files, the cotton production statistics, and the protectorate treaties

tuples.episode_object: Russian Orthodoxy, told as one long institutional life
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole country across eleven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a church that was made a department of state and lost the independence that had made it the country's moral authority
tuples.evidence_lens: the synod records, monastic land registers, the church council documents, and the secularisation inventories

tuples.episode_object: the Russian bureaucracy and its ranks, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole empire across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a table of ranks that let service produce nobility, which recruited talent and made the state the only career worth having
tuples.evidence_lens: the service and rank records, ministry files, personnel registers, and the memoirs of officials

tuples.episode_object: Russian famine and agriculture, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the black earth belt, the north and the steppe across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a grain-exporting country with recurring famines, because the export and the subsistence came from the same harvest
tuples.evidence_lens: the harvest and export statistics, the famine relief records, the zemstvo reports, and the price series

tuples.episode_object: the Russian revolutionary movement, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the cities, the universities and the exile communities across a century
tuples.mechanism: a movement created partly by the state's own education policy, and radicalised by having no legal outlet at all
tuples.evidence_lens: the police and court files, the underground press, the exile correspondence, and the trial records

tuples.episode_object: the Trans-Siberian railway, told as the whole life of one line
tuples.time_place_scope: the country from the Urals to the Pacific across a century and a quarter
tuples.mechanism: a railway built for strategy rather than for traffic, which moved millions of settlers as a side effect
tuples.evidence_lens: the construction records, the settlement and migration statistics, and the military transport files

tuples.episode_object: the end of the Russian empire, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole empire across two decades
tuples.mechanism: an empire that fought a war it could not supply, and dissolved along its frontiers before any successor could be agreed
tuples.evidence_lens: the war supply records, the duma debates, the provisional government files, and the treaties of the successor states

tuples.episode_object: the Polish-Lithuanian commonwealth, told whole from a union to three partitions
tuples.time_place_scope: the country between the Baltic, the Carpathians and the Dnieper across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: an elective monarchy with a noble veto, which guaranteed liberty for one class and paralysis for the state
tuples.evidence_lens: the diet records, the election capitulations, the land and tax registers, and the partition treaties

tuples.episode_object: Poland's medieval kingdom, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Vistula and Oder basins across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a kingdom repeatedly reassembled from divided duchies, whose crown was in the end handed to a foreign dynasty by marriage
tuples.evidence_lens: the royal charters, church records, town foundation documents, and the chronicles

tuples.episode_object: Lithuania's rise, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the country from the Baltic to the Black Sea across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: the last pagan state in Europe, which became the largest by absorbing Rus principalities and then converted for a marriage
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty and union documents, chancery records in several languages, and the chronicles of neighbours

tuples.episode_object: the union of Lublin and the commonwealth's constitution, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole commonwealth across two and a half centuries
tuples.mechanism: two states merged into one republic with one diet and two armies, which is a constitutional compromise that ages badly
tuples.evidence_lens: the union act, diet records, the noble assembly documents, and the military and treasury files

tuples.episode_object: the commonwealth's wars, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the country from the Baltic to the Black Sea across a century
tuples.mechanism: a state that fought Sweden, Russia and the Ottomans in one generation and never recovered its population or revenue
tuples.evidence_lens: the campaign records, tax and levy documents, demographic estimates, and the peace treaties

tuples.episode_object: the Cossack lands and the Ukrainian question, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Dnieper steppe and the frontier across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a frontier military society that neither neighbour could absorb or ignore, and which chose its overlord by treaty twice
tuples.evidence_lens: the register lists, the treaty texts, the commonwealth and Muscovite correspondence, and the chronicles

tuples.episode_object: Polish Jewry, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the commonwealth's towns and estates across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a community invited by charter for economic reasons, which became the largest in the world and was governed by its own council
tuples.evidence_lens: the royal charters, the council of four lands records, community books, and the tax and census registers

tuples.episode_object: Gdansk, Riga and the Baltic ports, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Baltic coast and its rivers across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: ports that exported a hinterland's grain and timber and were richer and more autonomous than the country behind them
tuples.evidence_lens: the port and toll records, the Hanseatic archives, the town council files, and the merchant correspondence

tuples.episode_object: the Polish partitions, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole commonwealth and its three neighbours across a quarter century
tuples.mechanism: the removal of a large European state from the map by agreement between its neighbours, in three stages
tuples.evidence_lens: the partition treaties, the reform constitution that provoked them, the diet records, and the insurrection documents

tuples.episode_object: the Polish emigration and insurrections, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Poland, western Europe and the exile centres across a century
tuples.mechanism: a national movement kept alive abroad for a century by exiles, poetry and periodic risings that all failed
tuples.evidence_lens: the emigration records, the insurrection files, the exile press, and the police and trial archives

tuples.episode_object: Prussia's Baltic provinces, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: east Prussia, the coast and the Vistula delta across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a Germanised order state turned duchy turned province, whose landowners supplied a kingdom's officer corps
tuples.evidence_lens: the estate records, the land registers, the military service files, and the administrative correspondence

tuples.episode_object: Estonia, Latvia and the Baltic Germans, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the eastern Baltic coast and its hinterland across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a country where the landowners and the peasants spoke different languages for seven hundred years, under four different sovereigns
tuples.evidence_lens: the manorial records, the church and revision registers, the guild and town archives, and the emancipation files

tuples.episode_object: Livonia and the Baltic crusades, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the eastern Baltic coast and its rivers across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: a crusade that ended in a colonial land settlement rather than a kingdom, and left an order governing a province
tuples.evidence_lens: the crusade chronicles, the order's records, castle and town archaeology, and the treaty documents

tuples.episode_object: Lithuania's peasants and language, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the forest country and the river valleys across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a language spoken by almost everyone and written by almost no one, revived by a ban that made printing it abroad necessary
tuples.evidence_lens: the printing ban records, the smuggled book routes, the census language data, and the folklore collections

tuples.episode_object: Belarus and the middle lands, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the country between the Bug and the Dnieper across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: a region that was the commonwealth's chancery heartland, then a border province of an empire, and repeatedly a battlefield
tuples.evidence_lens: the chancery records in the local language, land and tax registers, and the partition administration files

tuples.episode_object: the Baltic Sea trade, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole Baltic and its outlets across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: an inland sea exporting grain, timber, iron and tar to the west, whose toll at the exit funded a kingdom
tuples.evidence_lens: the Sound toll registers, the port records, freight contracts, and the naval and treaty documents

tuples.episode_object: Swedish Poland and the deluge, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the commonwealth and the Baltic across two decades
tuples.mechanism: an invasion that occupied most of a large state within months and left it demographically and economically wrecked
tuples.evidence_lens: the campaign records, the town destruction accounts, the tax and population data, and the peace treaties

tuples.episode_object: the Polish reform decade and its constitution, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the commonwealth across a decade
tuples.mechanism: the attempt to abolish the veto and the elective throne, which produced Europe's first modern written constitution and a partition
tuples.evidence_lens: the constitution text, diet debates, the confederation documents, and the neighbouring courts' correspondence

tuples.episode_object: Poland under three empires, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the partitioned lands across a century and a quarter
tuples.mechanism: one nation administered by three different states with three languages, laws and school systems, for four generations
tuples.evidence_lens: the three administrations' files, the school and language records, census data, and the underground press

tuples.episode_object: the Baltic states' first independence, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the eastern Baltic across two decades and after
tuples.mechanism: three small states created out of two collapsing empires, which had twenty years to build institutions from nothing
tuples.evidence_lens: the independence declarations, the land reform files, the parliamentary records, and the treaties of recognition

coverage_profiles.subject: the Danube lands and the Balkans

tuples.episode_object: the Balkans, told whole from Roman provinces to nation states
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula between the Danube, the Adriatic and the Aegean across two millennia
tuples.mechanism: a mountainous peninsula between three empires, where valleys stayed distinct and every frontier was somebody's border
tuples.evidence_lens: the successive imperial administrative records, church archives, the treaty texts, and the census data

tuples.episode_object: Roman and late antique Illyricum, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the western Balkans and the Danube frontier across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: a recruiting ground that supplied emperors and an invasion corridor that lost the empire its own interior
tuples.evidence_lens: the milestone and fortification records, the emperors' own inscriptions, and the settlement abandonment evidence

tuples.episode_object: Dalmatia and the Adriatic coast, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the eastern Adriatic shore and its islands across two and a half millennia
tuples.mechanism: a coast whose towns faced the sea and whose hinterland faced away, so that they belonged to different worlds
tuples.evidence_lens: the town statutes, the Venetian administration records, and the archaeology of the coastal towns

tuples.episode_object: Croatia, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the country between the Adriatic, the Drava and the Danube across thirteen centuries
tuples.mechanism: a kingdom in personal union with larger neighbours for eight hundred years, which preserved its institutions and never its autonomy
tuples.evidence_lens: the union documents, the diet records, the military frontier files, and the church archives

tuples.episode_object: Bosnia, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the mountains and river valleys of the central Balkans across nine centuries
tuples.mechanism: a mountain country with three faiths and a landholding system that mapped onto them, which every empire administered as an exception
tuples.evidence_lens: the medieval charters and grave monuments, the Ottoman land registers, and the provincial administration files

tuples.episode_object: Serbia's modern state, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Morava valley and the Danube across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a peasant uprising that became a principality by negotiation, and expanded by winning small wars at the right moments
tuples.evidence_lens: the uprising records, the treaty and firman texts, the assembly documents, and the census and land data

tuples.episode_object: Montenegro and the mountain principalities, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Adriatic mountains across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a country too poor and too vertical to conquer profitably, governed by a bishop-prince for two hundred years
tuples.evidence_lens: the prince-bishops' correspondence, the tribal assembly records, and the diplomatic files of the great powers

tuples.episode_object: Albania and the highlands, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the mountains and the Adriatic coast across two millennia
tuples.mechanism: a highland society governed by customary law between three empires, which became a state very late and very abruptly
tuples.evidence_lens: the customary law collections, the Ottoman administrative records, and the independence and boundary documents

tuples.episode_object: Greece's modern state, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Peloponnese, the mainland, the islands and the diaspora across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: an independence won by great power intervention, which set the pattern for every later Balkan settlement
tuples.evidence_lens: the war of independence records, the treaty texts, the assembly and constitution documents, and the loan files

tuples.episode_object: Romania and the Danubian principalities, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Carpathians, the Danube plain and the delta across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: two principalities under distant suzerainty, which united by electing the same prince twice on purpose
tuples.evidence_lens: the princely chancery records, the treaty and convention texts, the assembly documents, and the land reform files

tuples.episode_object: Transylvania, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Carpathian basin's eastern highland across a millennium
tuples.mechanism: a province with three recognised nations and four received religions, whose constitution was a written toleration
tuples.evidence_lens: the diet records, the union of nations documents, church and school archives, and the census data

tuples.episode_object: the Ottoman Balkans' end, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula from the Danube to the Aegean across a century
tuples.mechanism: the retreat of an empire province by province, each retreat producing a state and a population movement
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty texts, the population exchange records, the military campaign files, and the refugee registers

tuples.episode_object: Balkan Orthodoxy and its churches, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula and its monasteries across twelve centuries
tuples.mechanism: national churches created ahead of national states, which is why the church archives are the states' earliest records
tuples.evidence_lens: the patriarchal correspondence, the monastic charters and archives, and the autocephaly documents

tuples.episode_object: the Balkan Muslim communities, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Bosnia, Albania, Bulgaria and the Aegean across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: communities formed by conversion rather than settlement, and treated as foreign by the states that succeeded the empire
tuples.evidence_lens: the Ottoman land and tax registers, the community records, and the migration and exchange files

tuples.episode_object: Balkan cities and their populations, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula's towns from the Danube to the Aegean across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: cities that were mixed by trade and unmixed by nation-building, in the space of two generations
tuples.evidence_lens: the census and tax records, the guild and community archives, and the property transfer and exchange files

tuples.episode_object: the Danube as a river, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole river from the Black Forest to the delta across two millennia
tuples.mechanism: a river that was a frontier for four hundred years and a highway for the rest, and needed an international commission to work
tuples.evidence_lens: the frontier fortification records, the navigation commission archives, and the trade and shipping statistics

tuples.episode_object: Balkan brigandage and the mountains, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula's highlands across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: outlaw bands treated as criminals by the state and as resistance by the songs, which is a distinction the record cannot settle
tuples.evidence_lens: the court and campaign records, the folk song collections, and the consular and traveller reports

tuples.episode_object: the Balkan wars and the settlement, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula and the great powers across a decade
tuples.mechanism: two short wars that partitioned the remaining Ottoman Europe and left every border contested by somebody
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty texts, the boundary commission records, the campaign files, and the international inquiry report

tuples.episode_object: the Balkan diasporas, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the peninsula, the Ottoman cities, western Europe and the Americas across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: merchant and labour diasporas that funded the national movements at home from abroad
tuples.evidence_lens: the merchant company records, the remittance data, the emigration registers, and the diaspora press

tuples.episode_object: the Balkan boundary drawing, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the whole peninsula across a century
tuples.mechanism: a century of boundary commissions trying to draw lines through mixed populations, and the exchanges that followed each failure
tuples.evidence_lens: the commission reports and maps, the census and language data, the treaty texts, and the exchange convention files

tuples.episode_object: Sweden's empire, told whole from a Baltic kingdom to a lost hegemony
tuples.time_place_scope: Scandinavia, the Baltic coasts and central Europe across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a small population that fielded a large conscript army on copper and iron revenue, and could not replace it after one defeat
tuples.evidence_lens: the army and conscription registers, the mine and toll accounts, campaign records, and the peace treaties

tuples.episode_object: Denmark-Norway, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: Jutland, the islands, Norway, the Atlantic colonies and the sound across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: a twin kingdom whose revenue was a toll on a strait, which made every naval rival an existential enemy
tuples.evidence_lens: the sound toll registers, royal accounts, the colonial records, and the treaties of partition

tuples.episode_object: Finland between two crowns, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the lakes, the forests and the gulf coast across seven centuries
tuples.mechanism: a country administered in one language by one crown and then another, which built a national movement out of its own folklore
tuples.evidence_lens: the administrative records in two languages, the folklore collections, the diet documents, and the census data

tuples.episode_object: Norway's long union and independence, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the fjords, the coast and the north across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: four centuries under two different crowns, ended by a peaceful dissolution negotiated over one referendum
tuples.evidence_lens: the union documents, the parliament records, the referendum files, and the dissolution treaty

tuples.episode_object: Iceland after the commonwealth, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the island and the north Atlantic across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: a trading monopoly imposed on an island with one export, which held its population down for three hundred years
tuples.evidence_lens: the trade monopoly records, the parish and farm registers, the volcanic eruption accounts, and the sovereignty acts

tuples.episode_object: the Sami and the northern frontier, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the far north of Scandinavia and the Kola peninsula across two millennia
tuples.mechanism: a reindeer-herding people whose grazing lands crossed four states' borders, each of which taxed and schooled them separately
tuples.evidence_lens: the tax and border records of several states, the mission and school archives, and the herding rights litigation

tuples.episode_object: the Faroes, Shetland and the northern islands, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the north Atlantic islands across twelve centuries
tuples.mechanism: island communities transferred between crowns by pledge and treaty, whose law and language recorded each transfer
tuples.evidence_lens: the pledge and treaty documents, the law books, the parish registers, and the fisheries records

tuples.episode_object: Greenland after the Norse, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the island's coasts and the north Atlantic across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: an Inuit country recolonised as a trading and mission monopoly, and administered as a closed district for two centuries
tuples.evidence_lens: the trade company records, the mission archives, the census data, and the administrative reform documents

tuples.episode_object: the Kalmar union, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the three Scandinavian kingdoms across a century and a quarter
tuples.mechanism: three crowns on one head with three separate councils, which produced a permanent argument about who governed whom
tuples.evidence_lens: the union documents, the council records of each kingdom, and the campaign and coronation accounts

tuples.episode_object: the Baltic wars of the north, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Baltic, its coasts and the Russian frontier across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a two-hundred-year contest for the Baltic coasts, which exhausted every participant and settled it in favour of the largest
tuples.evidence_lens: the campaign records, the fleet and army accounts, the treaty texts, and the demographic data

tuples.episode_object: Scandinavian shipping and timber, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the forests, the fjords and the world's sea routes across four centuries
tuples.mechanism: an export of timber, tar and freight capacity that made small countries indispensable to larger navies
tuples.evidence_lens: the freight and toll records, the sawmill and forest accounts, and the ship registers

tuples.episode_object: the Scandinavian church and reformation, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the three kingdoms across five centuries
tuples.mechanism: a reformation carried out by kings for the land, which nationalised a church and funded a state in the same decade
tuples.evidence_lens: the church land inventories, the ordinance texts, the parish registers, and the visitation records

tuples.episode_object: Scandinavian emigration to America, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the countryside, the ports and the American midwest across a century
tuples.mechanism: the departure of a quarter of a rural population, and the letters home that recruited the next wave
tuples.evidence_lens: the emigration registers, the ship lists, the settlement records, and the emigrant letter collections

tuples.episode_object: the Norwegian and Icelandic fisheries, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern seas and the coasts across a millennium
tuples.mechanism: a fishery that fed Catholic Europe and set the political weather of every coast that supplied it
tuples.evidence_lens: the tithe and export records, the fishing station archaeology, and the price and catch series

tuples.episode_object: Scandinavian iron and copper, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the mining districts and the export ports across six centuries
tuples.mechanism: high-quality ore that funded armies and later industries, worked by a privileged mining community with its own law
tuples.evidence_lens: the mine and smelter accounts, the mining law and privileges, and the export statistics

tuples.episode_object: the Scandinavian folk movements, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the countryside and the towns of the three countries across a century
tuples.mechanism: temperance, free church and cooperative movements that trained a whole population in organising, before politics did
tuples.evidence_lens: the association records, the cooperative accounts, the newspapers, and the membership registers

tuples.episode_object: Scandinavian neutrality, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the three countries and their seas across two centuries
tuples.mechanism: a small state strategy that worked while the great powers needed the shipping, and failed exactly when they did not
tuples.evidence_lens: the diplomatic correspondence, the trade agreements, the naval records, and the wartime shipping data

tuples.episode_object: the Danish colonies, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the Caribbean, the Gold Coast and the Indian coast across three centuries
tuples.mechanism: small colonies bought and sold like assets, whose whole records fit in one archive and are unusually complete
tuples.evidence_lens: the company and colonial administration records, the plantation registers, and the sale and transfer treaties

tuples.episode_object: the Scandinavian languages, told as one long life
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern countries and their colonies across two millennia
tuples.mechanism: a dialect continuum turned into separate national languages by three separate standardisation projects and two alphabets
tuples.evidence_lens: the runic and manuscript record, the standardisation debates, the school records, and the dialect surveys

tuples.episode_object: the northern welfare settlement, told whole
tuples.time_place_scope: the three countries and Finland across a century
tuples.mechanism: a bargain between farmers and workers that traded free trade for social insurance, negotiated rather than imposed
tuples.evidence_lens: the agreement texts, the parliamentary records, the union and employer archives, and the budget series

tuples.episode_object: Alexander of Macedon, from a boy at a highland court to a body fought over in Babylon
tuples.time_place_scope: Macedon, Anatolia, Egypt, Persia and the Indus across thirty-three years
tuples.mechanism: a life spent moving forward because stopping would have exposed how little of the conquest had been made into government
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign histories written centuries later from lost eyewitnesses, coin issues, and the archaeology of the founded cities

tuples.episode_object: Julius Caesar, from a marked young man in a purge to a body on a senate floor
tuples.time_place_scope: Rome, Gaul, Iberia, Egypt and the Balkans across fifty-five years
tuples.mechanism: debt as a career strategy, in which a man borrows so heavily that only high command can save him from his creditors
tuples.evidence_lens: his own campaign accounts read as advocacy, hostile speeches, the coin record, and the letters of contemporaries

tuples.episode_object: Hannibal Barca, from a boy in Iberia to an exile's death in Anatolia
tuples.time_place_scope: Iberia, Gaul, Italy, Africa and the eastern Mediterranean across sixty-four years
tuples.mechanism: a general who could win any battle and never take a city, in a war decided by which side could recruit again
tuples.evidence_lens: the accounts of his enemies almost exclusively, checked against the archaeology of his route and the treaty texts

tuples.episode_object: Cyrus the Great, from a vassal prince to a death on a northern frontier
tuples.time_place_scope: the Iranian plateau, Media, Lydia and Babylon across roughly three decades of rule
tuples.mechanism: conquest by preserving local institutions and cults, which made surrender the cheaper option for every city he approached
tuples.evidence_lens: his own proclamation cylinder, Babylonian chronicles, and Greek accounts written a century afterwards

tuples.episode_object: Genghis Khan, from an outcast boy on the steppe to an empire divided between sons
tuples.time_place_scope: the Mongolian plateau, north China, Central Asia and Iran across roughly sixty-five years
tuples.mechanism: loyalty engineered by rewarding merit across tribal lines, which produced an army no rival confederation could fracture
tuples.evidence_lens: a dynastic history compiled for his heirs, the accounts of the conquered, and the terse Chinese and Persian records

tuples.episode_object: Timur, from a minor lord with a wound to a death on the road to China
tuples.time_place_scope: Central Asia, Iran, India, the Caucasus and Anatolia across sixty-nine years
tuples.mechanism: a conqueror who ruled through a figurehead lineage because he lacked the descent to rule in his own name
tuples.evidence_lens: court histories written to his order, the accounts of his victims, and the buildings and inscriptions he left

tuples.episode_object: Attila, from a joint king on the Danube to a death on his wedding night
tuples.time_place_scope: the Danube basin, Gaul and Italy across roughly two decades of rule
tuples.mechanism: an empire whose only institution was tribute, which meant every year required a new threat to renew the payments
tuples.evidence_lens: an eyewitness embassy account preserved in fragments, Roman diplomatic records, and the archaeology of the plain

tuples.episode_object: Charlemagne, from a joint heir to an emperor buried at his own chapel
tuples.time_place_scope: Gaul, Germany, Italy, the Danube and the Pyrenees across seventy-two years
tuples.mechanism: a lifetime of annual campaigning that produced an empire, and a written administration invented to hold it in his absence
tuples.evidence_lens: the royal annals, his capitularies, a court biography modelled on a Roman one, and the coin and charter record

tuples.episode_object: Saladin, from a reluctant young officer to a ruler who died without money
tuples.time_place_scope: Egypt, Syria, the Levant and Mesopotamia across fifty-six years
tuples.mechanism: the assembly of a coalition against a common enemy, and the way such a coalition dissolves once the enemy is contained
tuples.evidence_lens: chancery documents and letters, the accounts of his own secretaries, and the chronicles of his opponents

tuples.episode_object: Babur, from a boy king losing a small kingdom to a founder buried in Kabul
tuples.time_place_scope: Central Asia, Afghanistan and northern India across forty-seven years
tuples.mechanism: a life of repeated failure in one country converted into success in another that he had not originally wanted
tuples.evidence_lens: his own memoir, unusually candid and self-interested at once, plus court histories and the coin record

tuples.episode_object: Scipio Africanus, from a survivor of a massacre to a bitter retirement
tuples.time_place_scope: Italy, Iberia and north Africa across fifty-three years
